reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: It’s great I’m just sad it went subscription based, I logged in with google and didn’t keep my full version. That’s pretty sad to me since I switched to iOS.

reviews.title: Less is more
reviews.text: Just make it open the list when we open the app.

reviews.title: Running in background
reviews.text: App won’t stop running in the background. Keeps giving me alerts on my home screen. I like the list sharing ability, but until I figure out how to stop the background alerts, I am disappointed.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: I have been using this app and sharing the lists with my wife for years. Within the last couple days I have not been able to sync our lists together. I’ve tried refreshing the page on both our phones and also restarting both our phones. I don’t know why it’s not syncing now. Up until now it has been a great app and has made creating our grocery list easy. I hope we can continue using this app, but if it does not sync we will be deleting it and trying something else.

reviews.title: Greed isn’t good
reviews.text:
I’m using the app for many years, but this is slowly becoming unbearable.
I understand adverts, it’s pay developer’s salary, but this is going too far.
Full screen annoying ads with invisible closing it’s not what you want when entering the supermarket. And the need to kill the app in order to see your shopping list again only gives more time to think about how frustrating it is.

Moving adverts next to input line when adding items just to make more difficult to not tap on it appears to be minor crime here but it’s almost as annoying as the first, full screen advert of childish game i’ll never play

reviews.title: Ads are out of hand now
reviews.text: The ads have gotten so bad, I just close the app and use something else.  I understand I can pay for an ad free version, but at this point, just use something else unless you want another subscription. The small ads before were manageable and I didn’t mind seeing them but this whole page take-over is way too excessive.

reviews.title: Worse and worse
reviews.text: After the last update app is crashing, cannot type anything, more and more ads, redundant features, but the most important one - the list - is not working

reviews.title: New version bad
reviews.text: Newest version has ads that block out almost entire list.

reviews.title: unusable after updating
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for years and bought the ad-free version long ago

unfortunately, after the recent updates its become unusable. it closes as soon as I open it, I can’t even report a problem in app bc it won’t stay open to do so

reviews.title: Confused
reviews.text:
I purchased using the promotional offer but it will not allow me to share with anyone. When I click on the application settings in their menu there is nothing there about sharing and when I click the button to go to settings it takes me to the iPhone feature settings for the app, again nothing about sharing.

I would not have purchased if I knew this. I definitely will not renew

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: I open the app, it says there’s nothing in there. All of my grocery lists are gone. I don’t know why, I didn’t remove them. I opened it again, they’re in there. I add things, I close the app, I reopen them, they’re missing. Everything is gone. I closed the app and opened it again, there it is. I don’t understand why a simple grocery list malfunctions so much. I wonder if it has to do with all the suggestions they put in here and they try and sell us stuff? How about less sales, more grocery list?

reviews.title: Spam
reviews.text: I’m tired of items added to my list from your advertisers.  It’s ridiculous!
